owner.summary: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer specializing in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, and enterprise Kubernetes/OpenShift orchestration. Proven expertise in architecting zero trust cloud network topologies, designing production grade Infrastructure as Code (IaC) via Terraform and Ansible, and building resilient Python driven CI/CD delivery pipelines. Demonstrated success integrating OpenShift workloads with IBM FileNet, IBM MQ, and RabbitMQ, migrating on premises microservices to containerized GKE clusters, securing air gapped networks, and maintaining 99.9% availability across multi cloud and high performance GPU cluster infrastructures.
